components.title: compliant-s3
components.description: Reusable Terraform pattern for an AWS S3 primary bucket plus a dedicated access-log bucket. Hardcodes server-side encryption, versioning, public access block, access logging, and required compliance tags. Source: tools/terraform/primitives/compliant-s3.
components.purpose: Provide a compliant-by-default S3 primitive that any team can adopt with three lines of consumer Terraform.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST 800-53 Rev 5 controls satisfied by this module. Evidence is captured and signed by the grc-gate GitHub Actions workflow on every pull request against this module and uploaded to the evidence vault.

implemented-requirements.description: AES-256 server-side encryption is enforced via aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration.primary. Hardcoded; consumers cannot override. Gated in CI by Conftest namespace compliance.sc28_aws.

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle (GitHub Actions run 31727137821) containing terraform plan.json, plan.txt, conftest-results.json, and tfsec.sarif. Retained under COMPLIANCE lock for 400 days.

implemented-requirements.description: Public access is fully blocked via aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.primary (block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, restrict_public_buckets all true). Gated in CI by Conftest namespace compliance.ac3_aws.

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle (GitHub Actions run 31727137821) containing terraform plan.json, plan.txt, conftest-results.json, and tfsec.sarif. Retained under COMPLIANCE lock for 400 days.

implemented-requirements.description: Server access logging is enabled via aws_s3_bucket_logging.primary, writing access-log records to a dedicated, encrypted, non-public log bucket (aws_s3_bucket.log). Not yet gated by a dedicated Conftest namespace; presence is verified from plan.json in the same evidence bundle.

implemented-requirements.description: Object versioning is enabled via aws_s3_bucket_versioning.primary, and required compliance tags (Project, Environment, ManagedBy, ComplianceScope) are applied to every taggable resource via the provider's default_tags block, removing the chance of a resource being created untagged. Gated in CI by Conftest namespace compliance.cm6_aws.
